Pocket “rainbow reader” illustration in Firefox

A spot illustration shipped in Firefox’s Pocket panel: a person reading on a laptop while a rainbow loops out of the screen and over their raised legs.

Source
Firefox source (gecko-dev): Pocket panel images
Creator
Mozilla (illustrator not named)
Made
2020 (date given on Commons)
Style
Corporate Memphis (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Playful, relaxed, bright
Evidence
Inspected a 1280 × 1045 rendering of the SVG from Wikimedia Commons and stored it, flattened onto white. The Commons uploader placed it in Category:Corporate Memphis.
Reviewed
28 September 2026
Rights
Open license, stored. License: MPL-2.0. Rights policy

Context

Commons gives the source as the Pocket panel image folder of the Firefox source code, the author as “Mozilla Foundation et al.”, the date as 2020, and the license as MPL 2.0. Wikimedia Commons.

Observed

  • A figure lies on its front with a green sweater and reads a white laptop outlined in black.
  • A pale blue leg runs from the bottom left and bends up; the foot in a red shoe is drawn with black lines.
  • A wide rainbow of light blue, teal, yellow, red, and pink bands loops from the laptop screen over the figure in an S-curve.
  • The hair is a solid black mass; the face is white with a few black lines. Pink key shapes sit on the laptop keyboard.

Why it belongs

It shows how the style reached browser chrome and empty states: one figure and one oversized, impossible object in a small panel. The black hand-drawn line details make it a looser, sketch-like variant.

Borrow

Let a single flowing shape (a rainbow, a ribbon) come out of the device the figure uses, to show the feature’s effect.
